_note: Linking words and discourse markers, loaded by other-tools/import-connectives.js. These are absent from the SAT/IELTS source lists, which only carry advanced vocabulary - yet they are the words that actually hold an IELTS Writing Task 2 argument together. Some entries (nevertheless, conversely, whereas, hence, ...) already exist in the vocabulary table; the importer links and tags them without overwriting their existing meanings.

words.english_meaning: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was just said
words.example: The policy is popular. However, it is expensive to run.

words.english_meaning: used to link two contrasting ideas
words.example: The idea is simple but effective.

words.english_meaning: in spite of that; nevertheless
words.example: The evidence is thin, yet the conclusion is confident.

words.english_meaning: as an alternative to something mentioned
words.example: Do not ban cars; instead, invest in public transport.

words.english_meaning: used to say the opposite of what was just stated is true
words.example: This is not a minor issue; on the contrary, it is central.

words.english_meaning: used to introduce the second of two contrasting viewpoints
words.example: Cities offer jobs. On the other hand, they are crowded and costly.

words.english_meaning: used to compare two clearly different things
words.example: Rural areas are emptying. In contrast, cities keep growing.

words.english_meaning: used to correct or replace what was just said
words.example: The problem is not funding, but rather management.

words.english_meaning: different from; in contrast to
words.example: Unlike its neighbours, the country taxes fuel heavily.
words.synonyms: in contrast to, as opposed to

words.english_meaning: in contrast with; rather than
words.example: Funding should target prevention as opposed to treatment.

words.english_meaning: used to connect words or ideas of the same kind
words.example: The scheme is cheap and easy to administer.

words.english_meaning: used to add a further point that supports the argument
words.example: The plan is costly. Moreover, it has never been tested.

words.english_meaning: in addition to what has been said
words.example: Besides being expensive, the scheme is hard to enforce.

words.english_meaning: in addition; too
words.example: The reform also reduced waiting times.

words.english_meaning: used to introduce a further point
words.example: In addition, the policy created several thousand jobs.

words.english_meaning: used to add a point that strengthens the previous one
words.example: The drug is cheap; what is more, it has few side effects.

words.english_meaning: used to add something further, often as an afterthought
words.example: It wastes money, not to mention time.

words.english_meaning: combined with; together with
words.example: Poor planning, coupled with weak funding, doomed the project.

words.english_meaning: for the reason that
words.example: Rents rose because supply failed to keep up.

words.english_meaning: for the reason that; given that
words.example: Since demand is rising, prices will follow.

words.english_meaning: for that reason; as a result
words.example: The data are incomplete; therefore the conclusion is provisional.

words.english_meaning: as a result of what has just been said
words.example: Costs fell, thus making the service affordable.

words.english_meaning: because of the thing just mentioned
words.example: Funding was cut; as a result, waiting lists grew.

words.english_meaning: because of
words.example: The delay was owing to a shortage of materials.

words.english_meaning: caused by; because of
words.example: The rise is due to changes in migration.

words.english_meaning: because of what has just been explained
words.example: For this reason, the committee rejected the proposal.

words.english_meaning: with the purpose or result that
words.example: Subsidies were introduced so that poorer families could afford care.

words.english_meaning: to cause something to happen or exist
words.example: Rapid growth gave rise to serious housing shortages.

words.english_meaning: to be caused by or originate in
words.example: The dispute stems from a misreading of the contract.

words.english_meaning: despite the fact that
words.example: Although the study is small, its findings are striking.

words.english_meaning: despite the fact that; however
words.example: It is expensive, though arguably worth it.

words.english_meaning: despite the fact that, used for emphasis
words.example: Even though costs rose, demand held steady.

words.english_meaning: although; even if (used before an adjective or phrase)
words.example: The reform worked, albeit slowly.

words.english_meaning: without being affected by; despite
words.example: In spite of the warnings, construction continued.

words.english_meaning: used to concede a point before arguing against it
words.example: Admittedly, the sample was small, but the trend is clear.

words.english_meaning: used to admit that something is true before making a contrary point
words.vietnamese_meaning: cứ cho là, phải công nhận là
words.example: Granted, the cost is high; the alternative is higher.

words.english_meaning: although; whereas (used to concede or contrast)
words.example: While the theory is elegant, the evidence is weak.

words.english_meaning: without being affected by something
words.example: The rule applies regardless of income.

words.english_meaning: in spite of that; however
words.vietnamese_meaning: tuy vậy, dù sao đi nữa
words.example: The costs are high; nevertheless, the benefits justify them.

words.english_meaning: used to emphasise or confirm a preceding statement
words.example: The effect is large; indeed, it is the largest recorded.

words.english_meaning: used to add emphasis or correct an impression
words.example: It is not rare; in fact, it affects one in five.

words.english_meaning: especially; more than usually
words.example: This is true particularly of low-income households.

words.english_meaning: to a great extent; above all
words.example: Air quality matters, especially for children.

words.english_meaning: most importantly of all
words.example: Above all, the policy must be enforceable.

words.english_meaning: in a way that is extremely important
words.example: Crucially, the trial included a control group.

words.english_meaning: in a way that is very noticeable
words.example: Outcomes improved markedly after the reform.

words.english_meaning: in a way large enough to be important
words.example: Emissions fell significantly over the decade.

words.english_meaning: in a way that leaves no doubt
words.example: Clearly, the current approach is not working.

words.english_meaning: especially; more than others
words.example: One finding in particular deserves attention.

words.english_meaning: used to say something can be argued but is not certain
words.example: This is arguably the most important reform of the decade.

words.english_meaning: apparently, but perhaps not really
words.vietnamese_meaning: bề ngoài thì, có vẻ như
words.example: The fund is ostensibly independent of government.

words.english_meaning: appearing to be true, though possibly not
words.example: The two findings are seemingly contradictory.

words.english_meaning: according to what seems or is reported to be true
words.example: The decision was apparently taken without consultation.

words.english_meaning: used to say something is probably true
words.example: The gap is presumably due to reporting differences.

words.english_meaning: according to what is claimed, though possibly untrue
words.example: The document was purportedly written in 1890.

words.english_meaning: said to be the case, but without proof
words.vietnamese_meaning: bị cho là, theo cáo buộc
words.example: The firm allegedly under-reported its emissions.

words.english_meaning: partly, but not completely
words.vietnamese_meaning: ở một mức độ nào đó
words.example: This is true to some extent, though not universally.

words.english_meaning: generally speaking; on the whole
words.example: By and large, the reforms have been welcomed.

words.english_meaning: to be likely to do something regularly
words.example: Younger workers tend to change jobs more often.
words.synonyms: be inclined to, be apt to

words.english_meaning: less so, but still to some degree
words.example: This applies to rural areas and, to a lesser extent, to towns.

words.english_meaning: used to make a word, phrase or clause negative
words.example: The evidence does not support that conclusion.

words.english_meaning: not one nor the other of two things
words.example: Neither explanation fits the data.

words.english_meaning: and not; used after a negative statement
words.example: The plan is not cheap, nor is it quick.

words.english_meaning: at no time; not ever
words.example: The policy was never formally adopted.

words.english_meaning: almost not; scarcely
words.example: The change hardly affected overall costs.

words.english_meaning: almost not at all
words.example: The report scarcely mentions the environmental cost.

words.english_meaning: only just; almost not
words.vietnamese_meaning: chỉ vừa đủ, hầu như không
words.example: Wages barely kept pace with inflation.

words.english_meaning: not at all; certainly not
words.example: The matter is by no means settled.
words.synonyms: not at all, in no way

words.english_meaning: not at all; the opposite of
words.vietnamese_meaning: còn lâu mới, hoàn toàn không
words.example: The results are far from conclusive.

words.english_meaning: used to say something is even less likely than what was mentioned
words.example: Few can afford rent, let alone a mortgage.

words.english_meaning: used to restate something more clearly
words.example: Demand outstripped supply; in other words, prices rose.
words.synonyms: that is to say, put differently

words.english_meaning: used to clarify or restate a point
words.example: It halved, that is to say it fell by fifty per cent.

words.english_meaning: used to introduce an example
words.example: Some cities, Tokyo for instance, have solved this.

words.english_meaning: considering; because of new information
words.example: In light of these findings, the guidance was revised.

words.english_meaning: after considering all the arguments
words.vietnamese_meaning: xét cho cùng, cân nhắc mọi mặt
words.example: On balance, the benefits outweigh the risks.

words.english_meaning: used to introduce a final summary
words.example: In conclusion, reform is necessary but not sufficient.

words.english_meaning: in spite of that; nevertheless
words.example: The trial was small; nonetheless, its results were replicated.

words.english_meaning: in an opposite way; from the other point of view
words.example: Cities are growing; conversely, villages are emptying.

words.english_meaning: in contrast with the fact that
words.example: The north relies on coal, whereas the south uses gas.

words.english_meaning: in spite of; despite
words.example: Notwithstanding the cost, the project went ahead.

words.english_meaning: without being affected by
words.example: Despite repeated warnings, the practice continued.

words.english_meaning: used to suggest another possibility
words.example: Raise taxes; alternatively, cut spending.

words.english_meaning: in addition; besides
words.example: The scheme is costly. Furthermore, it is hard to police.

words.english_meaning: as an extra point
words.example: Additionally, the report calls for stricter limits.

words.english_meaning: in the same way; similarly
words.example: Exports fell; imports likewise declined.

words.english_meaning: in a like manner
words.example: Similarly, rural clinics reported longer waits.

words.english_meaning: for this reason; therefore
words.example: Supply is limited, hence the high price.

words.english_meaning: as a result
words.example: Rain failed; consequently, harvests collapsed.

words.english_meaning: by that means; with the result that
words.example: The law capped rents, thereby easing pressure on tenants.

words.english_meaning: in a way that is appropriate to what has happened
words.example: Demand shifted and prices moved accordingly.

words.english_meaning: especially; in particular
words.vietnamese_meaning: đáng chú ý, đặc biệt là
words.example: Several countries, notably Japan, face this problem.

words.english_meaning: opposite in nature or direction
words.example: Contrary to expectations, turnout rose.
